hints.title: Even Number of Digits
hints.text: An integer can only be symmetric if its total number of digits 2m is even.

hints.title: Digit Sum Comparison
hints.text: Convert each number into string or inspect digits, checking if sum of the first m digits equals sum of the last m digits.

hints.title: Range Scan
hints.text: Iterate through all integers from low to high and increment count for every matching integer.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct digit inspection for each integer.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Range size is at most 10^4, so direct iteration is fast and clean.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond small string representation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check even digit length and sum equivalence correctly.
